messages:
Sam (CS): Drafting a short "pilot pulse" one-sheet for customers — action-first guidance on caching, batching, streaming, plus simple renewal-risk indicators. Want quick checks before we send in the onboarding email.

Iris (Eng): Nice. Suggest conservative defaults for first 72h: batch window 30ms or 5 requests, server-side cap 48 requests OR 200 tokens per batch.

Sam (CS): Customer-facing 3-step checklist (copyable):
1) Set an initial token budget and SLA expectations (example: 4k tokens/day per active user).
2) Turn on route-level cache (TTL=30s) using key pattern tenant|route|prompt_prefix to boost repeat-hit flows.
3) Enable streaming for UI flows that benefit from partial responses (search, chat).

Noah (SRE): Warm pool guidance for pilots: recommend a range — 12 workers per 80 tenants; apply startup jitter 02s. Share a lightweight readiness probe snippet customers can paste:

readinessProbe:
  httpGet:
    path: /readyz
    port: 8080
  initialDelaySeconds: 6
  periodSeconds: 5
  failureThreshold: 3

Iris (Eng): SDK pseudo for client batching we can share:
// pseudo
batcher.add(req)
setTimeout(() => batcher.flush(), 30)
if (batch.length >= 5) batcher.flush()

Ellen (PM): Proposed renewal-risk signals to surface in dashboards and playbooks:
- Usage: 14d MAU drop >=25% -> Flag for engagement.
- Quality: sustained p95 latency >1.6x baseline for 72h -> Auto-escalate to SRE and enable fallback routing.
- Reliability: error rate >0.7% with an open ticket -> CS-led bridgecall + remediation plan.
Suggested mitigations: prefetch top 5 prompts for heavy flows, temporarily route to smaller model, increase warm pool briefly during expected spikes.

Sam (CS): Also include a short 'if things go wrong' ladder for customers:
- small latency blip: enable streaming + warmup prefetch.
- steady latency regression: reduce model size for non-critical routes.
- sustained errors: open a support bridge and apply circuit-breaker (reject non-essential routes).

ops-bot: Runbook entry created: runbooks/cs/pilot-pulse-v1 :page_facing_up:

Sam (CS): I'll turn this into a one-line snippet for the onboarding email and keep exact sizing ranges in the internal checklist. Thanks all :raised_hands:
